{{Quote|All by his lonesome ''[Dellso]'' found a previously-hidden droid factory, fired it up, and cranked out his own private army of battle droids.|[[Retired clone trooper]]|<ref name="Battlefront II" />}}
'''Gizor Dellso's droid foundry''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing facility]] on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] built on the side of a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] nearby the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]]. It was owned by [[Klegger Corporation]], which in turn served the interests of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].

After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] [[Gizor Dellso]] restarted the droid foundry for the creation of his own [[Gizor Dellso's army|army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. As part of his resistance against the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly-christened]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] he developed a prototype of an advanced [[Confederate infantry prototype|super battle droid]] in this facility.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

==History==
[[File:BF_Mustafar_5.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Battle droids produced by Gizor Delso using this factory engaging soldiers of the Imperial 501st legion.]]
As Gizor's [[Army/Legends|army]] grew [[Standard year/Legends|day]] by day, the Empire [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|sent]] the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to Mustafar to [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|destroy]] the droid foundry. 501st troopers were deployed on a landing platform outside the droid facility on Mustafar. Many had just stepped foot on the platform when droids shot them dead from the open windows of the entrance corridor. As [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] scurried out onto the landing platform, the 501st repelled them. They managed to secure their landing zone then stormed into the corridors, eventually pushing their way into the lava observatory room, which granted them access to an outside walkway. Despite [[Battle droid assassin|battle droid snipers]] firing at them, the stormtroopers were able to capture the walkway.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

Under orders to destroy the foundry, the 501st planted an orbital strike beacon on the overlook to signal for the orbiting [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] to bombard the base. However, Gizor Dellso and his Geonosian bodyguards arrived in a last-ditch effort to oust the 501st. Though many stormtroopers were slain, Gizor Dellso was killed along with his remaining droids.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

The troopers had just enough time to withdraw when their overhead forces executed an orbital bombardment command on the Mustafar complex, completely demolishing the droid factory.<ref name="Battlefront II" />
